department: Department of Computer Science, Ying Wu College of Computing

deadline.value: The page gives December 15 (Fall) and October 15 (Spring) with no year.

gre_general.value: The computer science PhD requires the GRE, and it cannot be waived.
gre_general.quote: Results of the GRE examination. This is mandatory and cannot be waived

also.quote: Ying Wu College of Computing - GRE optional but strongly recommended for all MS applicants; GRE required for all PhD applicants

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Nearly all admitted PhD students are supported as research or teaching assistants, though support is competitive.
funding.quote: Nearly all Ph.D. students enrolled in the program are fully supported as Research Assistants (RAs) or Teaching Assistants (TAs)

also.quote: financial support is competitive and not all admitted students receive it

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
entry_route.quote: They must have a bachelor degree from an accredited institution

english_waiver.value: The English test can be waived with proof of a prior degree from an institution where instruction is in English.
english_waiver.quote: may be waived if the applicant provides proof of a prior degree at an institution where instruction is based on English

fee_waiver.value: The department waives the application fee only for financial hardship, on request.
fee_waiver.quote: to ask for a fee waiver based on financial hardship, please contact csPhDProgram@njit.edu

notes: The department page states the $75 application fee, the same as the university record.
